Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL5483194 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter by assay chembl_id. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
